objective: Sports-only professional Counter-Strike BO3/BO5 series probabilities competitive with time-aligned bookmaker forecasts
holdout_limits: All previously scored IDs and the entire earlier player cohort excluded from final scored TEST cases.
Raw historical outcomes already existed locally and informed earlier online states; this is previously unscored retrospective evaluation, not a prospective or wholly unseen-data study.
No forecast quality has been computed for the reserved cohort under this experiment.

features.update_policy: All queries use only complete earlier source-calendar days; same-day outcomes/statistics frozen out; deterministic simultaneous updates.

map_score_elo.observation: series map-win fraction or completed native map winner

features.performance: Prior verified five-participant team totals only, pooled player-round exposure and last10 measured series; availability/support explicit.
features.form: Prior5/10/30 series win rate;10/30 series map margin and opponent-adjusted residual; prior count, rest and activity.
features.valve: First-added global historical Git blobs, as-of max(snapshot date+7 days, first-addition committer UTC clock); latest global snapshot only; exact normalized team-name matching; highest-points org aggregate for multiple published rosters.

candidate_space.learned_probability_stacking: Not used unless based on genuinely chronological out-of-fold TRAIN forecasts.

selection.cohort: Fixed one-hour market-covered validation union; forecasts do not consume prices.
selection.tie_break: Candidate recipe lexicographic order when losses differ by <=1e-12.
selection.pre_test_freeze: Selected recipe, fitted artifacts, feature schema, source hashes and validation scores saved before TEST probability or loss computation.
selection.after_test: No reselection or hyperparameter tuning on this TEST cohort; new independent evidence required after failed confirmation.

market.clock: Earlier provider scheduled/actual start minus horizon, or source-day midnight; both state clocks strictly before origin. Model source-day opening must not follow origin.
market.reconstruction: Latest relevant terminal raw receipt per fixture/book; full historical state selection before cutoff, then activity/price/scope validity; no earlier-valid revival.
market.primary_benchmark: Equal-weight available-book consensus per native match; not executable or pooled independent book rows.

acceptance.sparse_book_policy: Report inconclusive; do not convert low power or a CI crossing zero into evidence of equivalence.

limitations: Literal historical organizations, not verified contemporary starting rosters or identity alias resolution.
2024+ is a game-era proxy; native source-calendar days and retrospectively collected provider state clocks are not certified publication timestamps.
Valve Git first-addition commit clock plus seven-day lag is conservative provenance, not independent proof of public release.
Historical benchmark does not establish access to limits, prices, bets or settlement at those clocks.
